notes.title: 1.3.7D Update - Save folders, Gifting, Bugfixes
notes.content: [p]Hey Neighbours!   [/p][p][/p][p]What a week huh? Today's update is small but important, it adds folder support in game to the save area, squashes some annoying bugs and add more balancing to gift giving, and energy drains. [/p][p][/p][p]Previously, when you opened the game it tried to detect the Steam overlay and if it was detected, it looked for save files in a folder with your 10 digit Steam UserID. If Steam wasn't detected then it defaulted to a local user folder called 0000000000. That was all good until the Steam extension couldn't detect Steam at all so it looked like there were no files... even though they were safe in the other folder! [/p][p][/p][p]The steam overlay stuff has been fixed now but to avoid this in the future and give you more options on where to store your files, I've added folder tabs to the save area. When you load in now, if you have Cloud Save enabled and a default local user folder, you'll see two tabs in your save area and you can switch between them. If it detects a folder that's not the 0000000000 one, it will default to that but whichever tab you have open is where files will be saved.[/p][p][/p][p]You can probably also make your own folders if you want to separate things more but I haven't tested that much so use at your own risk and as always, back up first![/p][p][/p][p]See you in Garland![/p][p][/p][p]  <3 Violet[/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664166/fabf16db8d59ac604e39318a6ce1d255de35624e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]_______________________________________________________________________[/p][p]Early Access 1.3.7D - Patch (PC and Mac) (Full and Demo)  - 23/07/25[/p][p]_______________________________________________________________________[/p][p]General:[/p][p]- Fixed camera crash during Man Hunt game (I believe this has been fixed but the circumstances are very specific so I couldn’t recreate 100% so please let me know if you experience it).[/p][p]- Fixed crash when completing specific tasks (Meet the Neighbours, Animal Photos)  in reverse order.[/p][p]- Nightly summary: adjusted formatting[/p][p]- Penny: fixed hovering on chair.[/p][p]- Intro I.D. cutscene: updated text[/p][p]- CatJake now only appears in Kirin’s room after completing Kirin’s PE 3.[/p][p]- Music: fixed incorrect music playing during tutorial days.[/p][p]- Fixed stuttering when trying to move during letterbox bars slide out.[/p][p]- Tasks: Photograph 8 animals- fixed sketches counting as animal photos.[/p][p]- Stake out: fixed incorrect notification[/p][p][/p][p]Inventory:[/p][p]- Gifting: adjusted NPC likes and dislikes across all items (will be reflected in the wiki in the next few days).[/p][p]- Energy: adjusted mental and physical energy gains from food.[/p][p]- Pricing: adjusted a few prices across items for balancing.[/p][p][/p][p]Save files:[/p][p]- Rearranged save area to show all user folders as tabs.[/p][p]- Default Local User folder: 0000000000 [/p][p]- Steam Cloud Save folder (if enabled): 10 digit Steam UserID.[/p][p]- If a Cloud Save folder is detected, the game will default to that folder on start up, if you want to save to the other folder, just switch tabs in the load area and then files will be saved to that folder.[/p][p]- Added button to copy folder file path to clipboard.[/p][p]- I will add the option to move files between folders eventually but for now you can do it either manually in file explorer or by loading a save and then resaving to an empty slot in your preferred folder.[/p][p]- Note that only saves in the Cloud Save folder will be uploaded to Steam Cloud.[/p][p][/p][p]Mac Users - Steam Cloudsave update:[/p][p]The cloud save functions appear to be working on Mac now with a few caveats:[/p][p]- Because of OS permissions, the Steam overlay isn’t detected on Mac often, previously that was what triggered the game to choose the Cloudsave folder rather than the Default Local User.[/p][p]- To counteract that, now, if the game detects a user folder that isn’t the local user number it will default to that folder on start up instead of the local user.[/p][p]- If you want to use your local folder for saves, just switch to that tab in the save area.[/p][p] I would be a lot more comfortable if I had a few more Mac testers though, if you’re a Mac player and are interested in testing please drop me a line in the Garland discord or by submitting a bug ticket <3[/p][p][/p][p]Optimisation:[/p][p]- Fixed cam shake effect speed at low FPS[/p][p]- Swapped texture pages to QOI format only for speed.[/p][p]- Added beginnings of system for manual texture load.[/p][p]- Fixed some input debug areas for low FPS.[/p][p]- Fixed NPC path walking speed at low FPS.[/p][p]- Fixed animal speed at low FPS.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 1.3.7C Hotfix - Steam CloudSave - Currently Disabled for Mac users!
notes.content: [p]Hey Neighbours!   [/p][p][/p][p]Build 1.3.7B had a required update to the third party extension that connects Gamemaker to Steam. Unfortunately that has caused some issues as the extension has a bug with recognizing the Steam connection in some circumstances. [/p][p]I was able to fix this in the Windows build but the fix doesn’t work on Mac and I can’t roll back to the previous Mac version for technical reasons. I’ve logged the bug with the extension’s dev and hopefully they will have a fix soon but in the meantime I’ll keep looking for Mac users.[/p][p][/p][p]  <3 Violet[/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664166/fabf16db8d59ac604e39318a6ce1d255de35624e.png"][/img]_______________________________________________________________________[/p][p]Early Access 1.3.7C - Hotfix (PC and Mac) (Full and Demo)  - 19/07/25[/p][p]_______________________________________________________________________[/p][p]The last update had a required upgrade of the third party extension that connects Gamemaker to Steam. Unfortunately that has caused some issues as the extension has a bug with connecting to Steam in some circumstances. [/p][p]I was able to fix this in the Windows but the fix doesn’t work on Mac and I can’t roll back to the previous Mac version for technical reasons. I’ve logged the bug with the extension’s dev and hopefully they will have a fix soon but in the meantime I’ll keep looking for another solution.[/p][p]Windows - Fixed issue with Steam not initialising.[/p][p]Mac - Steam Cloudsave and Steam related functions are currently not working. [/p][p]If you have Cloudsave enabled your save files are still safe in your user folder and if you want to continue playing while the issue is being solved you can follow these instructions:[/p][p]- Locate your save files in a folder similar to this: /Users/<YOUR USERNAME>/Library/Application Support/com.moonlightingarland.moonlight[/p][p]- Steam cloud save files are in the folder with a 10 digit user number.[/p][p]- Copy the .sav files in your user folder over to the default user folder named “0000000000”.[/p][p]- Play as usual.[/p][p]- Once Cloud save is enabled again, you can copy your save files back to the steam user folder and pick up again.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 1.3.6Y Update - Festivals, Hair Salon, Save Files
notes.content:
Hey Neighbours! 

Hope you're having a good month! It's finally getting colder here in Melbourne and I'm excited for winter!

This update marks a huge behind the scenes milestone in terms of development as almost all the content on the original early access roadmap is complete. It's hard to reflect this accurately in the changelog but I've rebuilt almost all of the systems stuff to a manageable state now. So instead of chasing my tail redoing my previous work, from here I can focus on new content, fixing bugs and polishing the gameplay so it's <fun>. That means adding more of your requests, pets, furniture, collectables, jobs, donatables and more mini games.

Festivals:
There are 6 new festivals in Garland to celebrate throughout the seasons including a special event to ring in the new year by watching the midnight fireworks from your rooftop with your friends. 
The rest of the festivals are like fun traveling markets with exclusive furniture and food to enjoy but as the Garland City Council expands it's budget I'll be adding more mini games and relationship events to them all as well.

Herbs:
You'll now find wild herbs sprouting all over Garland, use your cutters to snip them and you can collect all kinds of useful plants. These will be used for cooking and brewing herbal teas so start building a collection now. Don't forget to check out the beach for shells and the farm/mountains for mushrooms in autumn.

Speaking of foraging, the beach and university areas are now open to explore, though the Council is being slow at approving permits for new buildings there...

Save files:
This update is a big update to the format of save files which will allow better compatibility as well as straight up text editing of files. I've tried super hard to make everything as compatible as possible but I always recommend backing up your save file before upgrading and, as always, if you have any problems with the upgrade: just reach out in the discord and I'm happy to help!

We're holding a community movie night in the Garland discord community in early June, I'll be sharing behind the scenes stuff so make sure you drop by!

Thank you as always for sticking around with me this long, it's been a hell of a year so far and I'm excited for what's coming to Garland next!

<3 Violet

notes.title: 1.3.6W Update - Rankings, Buffs, Moving Apartments and More!
notes.content:
Hey Neighbours! 

Hope you’ve all been well! Time is flying but things are ticking along and I have a chunky update for you today, here are the most exciting bits:

Move apartments!
Regret your life choices after moving in to a specific building? Well now you can move to a bigger apartment or a different building. Each building has layouts for studio/1/2/3 bed apartments and each have their own quirks. Pay off your generous <Interest Free City Council Move In Loan> and then check the listings at the desk in Quality Real Estate to see what’s available and get to packing~

Personal and professional rank progressions!
You can now track and improve your progress at various job/personal aspects of life in Garland. Each area has 5 rankings to max out as you live your life and when you level up to a new rank, you’ll get new perks including things like: better sale prices for items, better earnings, better spawn, tool use or harvest rates etc.

Buffs!
In addition to the buffs you can get from ranking up a category, there are also now buffs applied with certain items eg. wearing the speedy shoes will boost your walking speed. You can also purchase Hannah’s Buffins (Buff Muffins, she thinks the name is hilarious) from the Medical Center for bonuses in a variety of categories that last the day.

Sounds!
I’ve started the process of adding in all the new sounds to make Garland feel more alive. The biggest changes you’ll notice here are in UI and menus, though the animal sounds are pretty fun too :D

Luck!
Good luck with that… 

Honestly there’s a bunch more stuff in the changelog but not a lot of space to write it here so please check it out. Next update will be festivals and tying off loose ends. 
See you in Garland!

<3 Violet

notes.title: 1.3.6U Update - Furniture, Storage, Stampcards, Steam Achievements and more!
notes.content:
Hey Neighbours! 

Welcome to 2025 in Garland! I hope you’ve all been well even though it’s certainly been an intense start to the new year. 

The first update for the year in Garland is a fun one both with front end stuff and polishing off a lot of back end junk so I can move on to more featurezzzz

First up is furniture! The antiques store is now selling some nice furniture so go check it out! By placing different kinds of furniture in your apartment you'll unlock category organisation tabs in your main storage area (which btw looks super nice now). I can't wait to see how you decorate your apartments :D

Next up I've added in the first batch of Steam Achievements. I know that this has been a long time request and once I'm sure everything is working properly in this update I'll be adding more with proper artwork. If you have any achievement suggestions let me know in the Garland discord!

The Council Initiatives stampcards have also gotten a rework and now you can have the satisfaction of smacking that stamp down when you complete them as well as: actual rewards for doing them. I know, very exciting! Just a quick note that while you can receive the reward items from Patrick, some of the tools attached aren't functional yet (speedy shoes don't make you go any faster right now but the kitty ear beret sure looks damn cute!). Hang on to them until next update and you'll be able to use them properly :D

Back end I’ve done a lot of optimising including adding fps control and texture changes which should help out those of you who are playing on machines with integrated graphics. There are still areas that are a work in progress so I’ll be ticking them off as I go along this year. 

Last thing I wanted to mention is that this year I'm going to be doing updates monthly rather than fortnightly. This will give me more time to fix bugs before updates go out and add larger features without having to stress about getting things out while I'm working on bug reports. The updates will be a lot chunkier for you guys too so it should be more fun coming back every month!

Anyway, hope you're all well and I'll be back next time possibly with the ability to move between apartments or upgrade! 

See you in Garland!

<3 Violet

notes.title: 1.3.6T Update - Fishing!

Hey Neighbours! 

Welcome to the last update of 2024 and congratulations for making it though the year, it’s certainly been a… time!

This update brings fishing and all the fun bits that come with it. It’s been a huge year for Garland, I’ve crossed a lot of things off the roadmap list but there is still more get done and I really appreciate you all sticking with me and having patience while I work things through. I’ll be posting a proper end of year wrap up in the discord so come join us to celebrate or make suggestions for what you want to see next year!

notes.title: 1.3.6S Update - Pets!
notes.content:
Hey Neighbours! 

We’re coming to the end of the year so this is the second last update for Garland for 2024 and it’s a fun one: PETS!

After Spring 25, the Pet Rescue adoption program will open (via a letter) and you’ll be able to adopt some furry friends! Currently there are 3 colours of cats with 3 personality types and different combinations will be available every morning. Once you adopt a friend, you’ll need to give them a bed and bowl to eat/drink from and take care of their needs every day. You can check your pet’s stats from the bed too and see if you’ve earned their love yet :D

Their reactions to you and how they respond to your care is based on personality so it’s going to take time and work to earn respect from the grumpier animals. Check the full changelog for more details of all the changes. I’ll be adding more mechanics and types of pets once I’ve got some more data on how we can balance the gameplay so feel free to give me your feedback in the discord community!

Also, a special thank you to our discord community for all the random cat names included so far too!

This update also brings the start of the furniture mechanics for decoration (so many sure you buy a hammer if you wanna redecorate!).

There will be one more update in Mid December before I take a break over the December holidays. It will include some more furniture and <hopefully> a couple of other big things for you to play with over the holiday break.

That’s all for today, see you in Garland!

notes.title: 1.3.6R Update - Museum, Clothes, Second Chances
notes.content:
Hey Neighbours!

What a week huh? *_* Update time I guess… This is a big features update so buckle in.

Second chances at love:
If you’ve completed a romance choice event, chosen the plutonic option and changed your mind later after getting to know someone you can now get a second (or third etc) chance at love. Purchase flowers at the wedding shop and give them to your romantic prospect. But there are no guarantees at love so reactions will depend on whether you’re in their good graces or not >:D

More complicated relationship dynamics:
When you have a life event with an NPC (break ups, divorce, marriage, dating), word gets around the city pretty quickly and you’ll find it effects the NPC’s close friends/family. Eg. If you ask Avery out you might find Cecile happy with you and Leon not so much.

Museum Donations:
Garland’s Museum of Unnatural History has completed its renovations and is now open for donations of Plants, Crystals and wildlife photos. You can track what you’ve already donated in your Collections app. There is currently no reward for donations but that’s coming soon with the Council update and will be applied retroactively to your save files so donate away!

Clothing and Customisations:
This update sees the way clothing and character customisation works backend get a complete overhaul to allow custom clothing and storage solutions in a future update. The clothing shop is now open and has a selection of items in various colours that rotates daily. You can now change your body/face at your bathroom mirror, and your personal options (name, favourites etc) at the Council via your Garland ID.

While all the new UI is done, I’m doing these changes over 2 updates because I didn’t want you to be stuck in an outfit you didn’t like and in the next update, you will no longer be able to select from <all> the customisation options in your phone menu as you’ll need to purchase shirts/pants/socks/shoes/accessories from the shops. So please make sure to pick your favorite outfit options before next update!

When you load into this version, your save file will be upgraded to handle the changes but as always, if you come across any problems please log them in the Discord’s bug reports channel! I’ve also fixed a bug that was causing some older files to default to the smaller inventory allowance, so if you have an old file you should be back to min 16 slots after this update, for some of you this will be a free inventory upgrade :D

Next update will be finishing off the customisation changes, changes to storage (sorting yay!) and either pets or fishing. I’m not sure if this will be in 2 weeks or 4 but I’ll be doing my best to get things out asap. I’ll also be taking a break between 23th Dec - 13th Jan this year so I won’t be as quick with replies during that time.

See you in Garland!

notes.title: 1.3.6M Update - Cloud Saves and Controller Updates
notes.content:
Hey Neighbours!

It's a pretty big one as today's update includes some (very) long awaited changes to the UI systems, controller support and save files for Steam Cloud Saves. So let's talk about the important bits!

[h3][b]Important: BEFORE YOU UPDATE PLEASE BACK UP YOUR SAVE FOLDER!! [/b][/h3]

[b]Save files / Steam Cloud Save[/b]
This update enables support for Steam Cloud Save which means you can continue your game between devices. For this to happen I've had to make a few changes to the structure and naming conventions of save files. When you open the game for the first time, it will automatically upgrade your files to the new format but PLEASE back up your save folder before opening just to be safe.

[b]Controller/Steamdeck Support[/b]
Full game play is now available with controller on PC and Steamdeck. Mac is still partially available because there are some issues with proper button registration that I'm working through (but I am on it!). All of the UI has been updated for this and there have been several changes to the controller maps so please look in game. On first load any old custom controls you've registered will be wiped but if you have any odd behaviour please reset them to default in the custom control settings.

I've still got a couple of back end UI things to take care of next update but we're on track now for more content soon. Next update will most likely be some relationship stuff, music/sound and a lot of small stuff that's been clogging up my to do list. 

As always, please report any bugs you find and thank you for your patience while I work my way through everything :hype: 

<3 Violet

Hey Neighbours!

Today's update is a bit special because it's got some fun new features and it's also the last in the 1.3.5 version line so next update we'll be moving to 1.3.6A <- very exciting!

Along with bug fixes (no more of those shockingly long dark tunnels during train travel), 1.3.5Z brings to new collection features: music and crystals.

Speaking of your house, the MP3 player that pops up when you look out your window will now keep track of your personal playlist. notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664166/6fb0ac4347e455e8ba0e43836d7c646eef8100b2.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 

I hope you are having a lovely week. Firstly I just want to say thank you to everyone who played the demo, provided feedback and wishlisted so far! Seeing everyone having fun in Garland has been really motivating and I appreciate the time everyone has taken to provide feedback and report bugs! 

This afternoon I've pushed the 1.3.3 update to the free demo of Moonlight in Garland which takes into account some of the feedback and patches a bunch of little bugs.

You can see the full detail of the changes [url=https://moonlightingarland.com/changelog/]in the changelog here[/url] but here are the most important ones:

[list]
[*] Updated player collisions to automatically free themselves when stuck on an object or NPC.
[*] Added a "Exit to apartment" button to the menu as an emergency exit in case you get stuck anyway.
[*] Fixed the issue with you current apartment not appearing on the load screen for some players. 
Note - if this happened on your file, you will need to go to the real estate agent window and re-pick your apartment.
[*] Added a menu screen when delivering quest items to the recycling bin to prevent accidentally selling your quest items
[*] Fixed the issue with some later quests not marking off properly (Meeting Cecile)
[/list]

I have also updated [url=https://wiki.moonlightingarland.com/]the wiki [/url]with general favorite locations for each NPC in case you have trouble finding them, though this is likely to change over the next few months as I continue development.

If you'd like to give feedback, report bugs or just say hi the feel free to join us in our discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/shajwZWvym][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664166/fabf16db8d59ac604e39318a6ce1d255de35624e.png[/img][/url]

That's everything for the moment, the next update will be in around a month and will be a feature update. 

See you in Garland!

<3 Violet
